            app.logger.warning(
                f"DATABASE_URL malformed: '{database_url}' - falling back to SQLite"

        app.config["SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI"] = database_url

        if "fso" not in inspector.get_table_names():

                try:

                        app.logger.warning(

                        )
                    else:
                        app.logger.info(
                            f"FSO startup sync: {result['inserted']} inserted, {result['updated']} updated"
                        )
                except Exception as e:
                    app.logger.error(f"FSO startup sync failed: {e!s}")

    # Redirect root to first tab (Sample -adjudication)

        app.celery = None

    concurrent workers never obtain the same value.  On PostgreSQL an
    advisory lock provides additional cross-process serialisation; on
